jess: Hey — running into an odd one in the sampleapp: Node SDK returns embedding length 1536, Go SDK returns 1535 for the exact same prompt. Repro steps below, anyone seen this?

jess: Node snippet:
```js
const r = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'rdw-embed-xl', input: 'hello'});
console.log(r.data[0].embedding.length); // 1536
```

jess: Go snippet:
```go
res, _ := client.Embeddings(ctx, EmbeddingsRequest{Model: "rdw-embed-xl", Input: "hello"})
fmt.Println(len(res.Data[0].Embedding)) // 1535
```

carlos: whoa. first guess: batching/padding mismatch between SDKs. Are you using the batching helper or direct calls?

jess: using the batching helper (Batcher.autoBatch) in both sampleapps. sampleapp versions: node 0.3.2, go 0.3.2.

mei: there was a recent change where auth refresh/retry path reconstructed requests. suspicious it might drop pad bytes on retry. saw something similar in internal logs.

jess: here's the raw debug logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-22T14:02:11Z] batching: final batch size 7, pad 1 zeros
[2026-03-22T14:02:11Z] send request id=abc123
[2026-03-22T14:02:11Z] auth: token expired, 401 -> refreshing
[2026-03-22T14:02:12Z] retry: resend request id=abc123 (padding info lost)
[2026-03-22T14:02:12Z] response received: vector_length=1535
```

carlos: that lines up. looks like retry route reconstructs body from live queue without the pad placeholder. node and go implemented pad logic slightly differently so only one SDK slipped.

raghu: can you attach the full payload + request headers and open a GH issue? need a minimal repro.

jess: done — created issue #4321 with traces and sampleapp snapshot. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/4321

sophia: i'll take the Node side patch to ensure pad info is persisted across retries. @carlos can you take Go? i'll add unit tests for both.

carlos: yep on it. plan: persist a small metadata block on the batch object with padCount, and ensure retry uses that block when rebuilding body. also add a debug flag to surface padding actions: `SDK_DEBUG_PAD=true`.

mei: for immediate workaround: call the single-item embed API (no batching) or explicitly set batchOptions.padToMultiple= true. sampleapp note: add env override `SDK_STRICT_PAD=1` until patch lands.

sophia: adding integration test to sampleapp: `scripts/compare-embeds.sh` that calls both SDKs and fails if dims differ.
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
node scripts/get-embed.js > node.json
go run scripts/get_embed.go > go.json
NODE_LEN=$(jq .data[0].embedding | jq length < node.json)
GO_LEN=$(jq .data[0].embedding | jq length < go.json)
if [ "$NODE_LEN" -ne "$GO_LEN" ]; then
  echo "Mismatch: node=$NODE_LEN go=$GO_LEN"; exit 2
fi
```

devex-bot: Deploy queued for branch `embed-pad-parity` (CI checks running) :package:

carlos: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/789 — adding retained pad metadata + unit tests.

raghu: once both PRs merge we'll cut a patch release and update sampleapp to 0.3.3. tagging customer-facing docs to mention the workaround.

jess: awesome, thanks everyone. will verify against my workspace and report back. :thumbsup: If anyone needs the raw traces I can paste them in the GH issue.

sophia: thanks, i'll be watching for the green CI and will merge after go side is ready.

jess: reopening note: if you still see parity mismatch after patch please add the request_id from logs and ping here.
